script_text: Mercury stations retrograde on the 13th and your entire week unravels before it even begins. Early week the Sun in your 6th House squares Saturn in Aries forcing you to choose between perfection and peace — Monday through Wednesday carry a tense Mars-Leo square to Jupiter in your 10th House that could launch your career or burn the bridge with your boss. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House bringing flirtation and creativity to the forefront. The turning point hits Thursday when Uranus in Gemini trines your 2nd House of income — unexpected money arrives. Weekend Mars sextiles Pluto in your 8th House deepening intimate financial partnerships. Friday is rough with Mercury retrograde opposing Neptune clouding your communication. Best day is Thursday. Worst day is Friday. Your ruling planet Mercury demands you edit before you speak this week. Follow for daily updates.
